---
title: "About"
---

**Faik Boray Tek** is an Associate Professor and Vice Chair in the Department of
Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering at Istanbul Technical University.
He works on artificial neural networks, (bio)medical image analysis, computer
vision, and computing education — recently on adaptive neuron and convolution
kernel models, and on deep-learning-based diagnosis from optical coherence
tomography.

Before ITU he was at Işık University, with earlier positions at the Heidelberg
Collaboratory for Image Processing, MedicSight PLC in London, the University of
Westminster, and TÜBİTAK-BİLTEN. His PhD, on computerised diagnosis of malaria,
is from the University of Westminster.

The longer version is on the [CV page](cv.qmd).

## About this site

Notes and experiments that are worth reporting but not worth a paper. Built with
[Quarto](https://quarto.org) and published from GitHub Pages; the source for
every post, including the scripts behind the figures, is in
[the repository](https://github.com/btekgit/btekgit.github.io).
